real_estate.text:
Источник: @realty_in_thailand
skhai
I was planning to buy a luxury villa in Phuket and looked into Skhais Sunrise Valley project. The sales process seemed professional at first: nice renderings, a polite manager, and promises of high-quality construction.
I decided to verify everything myself and visited completed projects in Bang Tao (Sunrise Garden and Sunrise Palms).
What I found:
 poorly painted walls
 crooked doors
 large gaps
 visible joints
 cracks and other defects
This is clearly not luxury quality.
According to villa owners:
 construction drawings and contracts are not followed
 mistakes are not acknowledged
 no compensation for poor work
 responses can take months
One major issue: pool equipment is installed right behind bedroom walls, causing constant loud noise  impossible to sleep.
Conclusion: I cannot recommend Skhai. The actual quality does not match the promises.
Advice: always visit completed projects and speak with owners. Relying only on marketing is risky.

Здания соединены между собой переходами, формируя единый комплекс, окруженный зеленью и прекрасными видами на озера и океан. В непосредственной близости от комплекса расположен Boat Avenue, различные рестораны, бары, магазины и прочая инфраструктура.
